146065.overview: 11-Puzzle (Puzzle Game, パズルゲーム, Pazurugēmu)  is a sliding tile puzzle game that challenges players to arrange numbered tiles in sequential order. Players must slide tiles one at a time into an empty space to solve the puzzle, testing their logic and planning skills. With its minimalist presentation and brain-teasing design, 11-Puzzle offers a portable and classic puzzle-solving experience ideal for short bursts of play or extended mental challenges.
